BLOCK / security - round 1 under C34

PR #246 at f3784caab656c1665c2daa469b283f60b2aa0065.
Two privacy-contract failures require forward fixes. Neither finding claims
credential theft or a new authorization bypass. Matched identifying values
are deliberately withheld.

| # | Severity | File | Lines | Vulnerability | Confidence |
|---|----------|------|-------|---------------|------------|
| 1 | ⚪ LOW | docs/plans/231-spawn-cache-line/plan.dd.json; plan.dd.md | 147; 171 | Added public plan text contains an account-bearing absolute worktree path | 10/10 |
| 2 | ⚪ LOW | crates/cli/src/main.rs | 4592-4595 | New human cache reason/fix can disclose account identifiers and machine-local paths | 10/10 |

S246-001: The identifying path is present in newly added current-head plan
source and its generated Markdown. This is not a historical-only exposure.
Replace it with a portable repository-relative reference, using the document
writer and regenerated view. C19 calls for a forward scrub, never a history
rewrite; C21 does not permit the private machine identity in this public text.

S246-002: Escaping is not redaction. The new helper renders the daemon's raw
reason and fix. Ordinary missing-account and readiness failures can embed
the configured account identifier, and configuration failures can embed
local paths. One ordinary chain is a configured account with no usable gh
token: token.rs generates the account-bearing reason, proxy.rs generates
an account-bearing repair, the daemon returns a successful plain-route
descriptor, and the CLI displays both. Producer locations:
crates/cache-proxy/src/token.rs:101-103;
crates/cache-proxy/src/readiness.rs:103,181,185;
crates/cache-proxy/src/proxy.rs:187,215-217. The daemon forwards these fields
at crates/daemon/src/cache_proxy.rs:248-255.
Use identity-free human display descriptions for both reason and fix, and
cover representative account-bearing and path-bearing failures. Preserve
the existing JSON envelope. This is a new human presentation of data already
available in the envelope, not a new credential-access boundary; it still
violates the requested identity-free receipt.
The new tests assert benign verbatim displays (main.rs:4840-4851) and newline
fencing (:4859-4865), but do not cover account/path-bearing failures.

Positive checks:
- Both dynamic fields pass through render::line. Existing control-character,
  line-separator and frame-text fencing remains at
  crates/core/src/render.rs:169-220.
- The new line requires human output, a successful envelope and a Copilot
  descriptor (crates/cli/src/main.rs:4608-4615;
  crates/core/src/model.rs:698-707). Setup refusals bypass it
  (main.rs:1390-1399); cheap revive prints it after revive and before the
  separately fallible compact (main.rs:1618-1630). JSON remains unchanged.
- No token or upstream-credential propagation was found. Token stdout is
  separate from error text (token.rs:92-104), and readiness errors omit URLs
  (readiness.rs:171-187). The added API documentation contains no credentials.
- All ten changed files, the complete two-sided diff, current PR title/body
  and complete PR commit messages were reviewed. Title/body and commit
  messages had no detected private identifier, email or machine-home leak.
  The current source has the two identifying documentation locations above.
- The case-insensitive exact-head git grep included tracked hidden files
  and reported locations only. Added-line results: two machine-home matches
  at S246-001; zero email or token-pattern matches. No identifying value is
  reproduced in this verdict.
  The full-tree account-like pattern was
  (account[_ -]?(login|name|id)|github[_ -]?(user|login)|"login"[[:space:]]*:|github\.com/[[:alnum:]_-]+|@[[:alnum:]_-]{3,}).
  The plan scan used
  (/Users/|/home/|[[:alnum:]._%+-]+@[[:alnum:].-]+\.[[:alpha:]]{2,}).
  Both ran with git grep -n -i -I -E at the requested head; matched output
